summary: Scranton mine laborer, born at Pittston in 1906, who died in Miami in 1971; John's great-granduncle.
bio:
Charles Thomas Petrillo, known as Charlie, was born on 13 November 1906 at Pittston, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, so the family briefly lived in Luzerne County; later in life he gave his birthplace as Scranton. He appears in the censuses of 1910 and 1920 under the names Charlie, Chas and Ralph.

In September 1934 he married Elsie Jaworski, a 21-year-old Polish-American waitress, in Scranton. In 1940 the couple rented one of the units in the family's building on Bunker Hill Street in Scranton, beside his brothers James and Nicholas, and Charles worked as a laborer doing outside work at the mines. He died in Miami, Florida, on 6 December 1971. He is John's great-granduncle.
